\(\tau_{r+1}\!\sim\!2^{r-1}\!/\!\!\left[2\sqrt{q}\!-\!\frac{1}{4}w\frac{(2w^{3}\!+\!3 )}{64\sqrt{q}}\!-\!\frac{(7w^{3}\!+\!47w)}{1024q}\!-\!\ldots\right]\)See **20.9.23**-**20.9.24** for expressions relating to _ce_,(0, _q_) and _se__e__i_'(0, _q_). When \(|\cos x|\!>\!\sqrt{4r\!+\!2/q}\), **20.9.11**-**20.9.12** are useful. The approximations become poorer as \(r\) increases.

### Expansions in Terms of Parabolic Cylinder Functions

(Good for angles close to \(\frac{1}{4\pi}\), for large values of \(q\), especially when \(|\cos\,x|\!<\!2^{l}/q^{k}\).) Due to Sips [20.44-20.46].

\(ee_{r}\!(x,\,q)\!\sim\!C_{r}\!(Z_{\alpha}(\alpha)\!+\!Z_{1}(\alpha)\)

\(se_{r+1}\!(x,\,q)\!\sim\!S_{r}\!(Z_{\alpha}(\alpha)\!-\!Z_{1}(\alpha))\sin\,x\), \(\alpha\!=\!2q^{4}\cos x\). Let \(D_{\kappa}\!\!=\!\!D_{\kappa}\!(\alpha)\!=\!(-1)^{\kappa}e^{\frac{1}{4\pi^{2} }}\frac{d^{n}}{d\alpha^{s}}\,e^{-1\kappa^{2}}\).

\(Z_{\alpha}\!(\alpha)\!\sim\!D_{r}\!+\!\frac{1}{4q^{l}}\!\left[\!-\!\frac{D_{r+ 4}}{16}\!+\!\frac{3}{2}\binom{r}{4}\,D_{r-4}\right]\)\(+\frac{1}{16q}\!\left[\!\frac{D_{r+ 9}}{512}\frac{(r\!+\!2)D_{r+ 4}}{16}\!+\!\frac{3}{2}\left(r\!-\!1\right)\binom{r}{4}\,D_{r-4}\right.\)

\(Z_{1}\!(\alpha)\!\sim\!\frac{1}{4q^{l}}\!\left[\!-\!\frac{1}{4}\,D_{r+ 2}\!\cdot\!\frac{r(r\!-\!1)}{4}\,D_{r-2}\right]\)\(+\frac{1}{16q}\!\left[\!\frac{D_{r+ 9}}{64}\!+\!\frac{(r^{2}\!-\!25r\!-\!36)}{64}\!D_{r+ 2}\right.\)

\(+\frac{r(r\!-\!1)(r\!-\!27\!+\!10)}{64}\!D_{r- 2}\!-\!\frac{45}{4}\binom{r}{6}\,D_{r- 5}\!+\!\ldots\right]\)

\(C_{r}\!\!\sim\!\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{\lambda q}\!q^{qj}\!(r!)^{\lambda q} \!\left[1\!+\!\frac{2r\!+\!1}{8q^{3}}\right.\)

\(\left.\!\!+\!\frac{r^{4}\!+\!2r^{3}\!+\!263r^{2}\!+\!262r\!+\!108}{2048q}\!+\! \frac{f_{1}}{16384q^{3}}\!+\!\ldots\right]\)

\(f_{2}\!\!=\!\!2r^{3}\!+\!5r^{4}\!-\!416r^{3}\!-\!629r^{2}\!-\!1162r\!-\!476\)It should be noted that **20.9.15** is also valid as an approximation for _se__r_+1(z, _q_), but **20.9.16** may give slightly better results. See [20.4.]
